_comment: HAND-WRITTEN STAND-IN for annotate.py's output, so relevance.py is runnable and testable today. Six real modelspec_clauses.json ids, atoms written by hand from the clause text. This is NOT a measurement artifact and must not be used to produce a headline number -- benchmark.py falls back to the unannotated path unless a real annotation file is passed. Shape is clause-major; load_annotations also accepts atom-major and flat (see relevance.py docstring). Note m0450 deliberately carries an atom with ONLY a name, to keep the tolerant-loader path exercised by real data and not just by a synthetic test.
